name: buildr-ios-skills
description: The official BuildrStudio (buildrstudio.in) suite of 21 AI Agent Skills for modern iOS, Swift 6, SwiftUI, SwiftData, StoreKit 2, Core Data, App Intents, Security, Multiplatform, Interface Polish, and Architecture.
author: BuildrStudio (buildrstudio.in)

skills.name: buildr-ui
skills.description: Modern SwiftUI architecture and API standards (iOS 17+ / iOS 18+). Covers the Observation framework (@Observable), type-safe navigation, clean state flow, and deprecation migrations.

skills.name: buildr-design
skills.description: Enforces Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) and native iOS aesthetics. Emphasizes restraint over decoration, strict 4/8-pt grid discipline, semantic system colors, and native controls.

skills.name: buildr-polish
skills.description: Interface polish and micro-interactions skill inspired by 'make-interfaces-feel-better'. Covers concentric corner radii, tactile spring press feedback, sensory haptics (iOS 17+), optical alignment, and tabular digits.

skills.name: buildr-arch
skills.description: Architectural playbook for Swift and iOS applications. Covers pattern selection (MVVM, Clean Architecture, TCA, Coordinator), dependency injection, unidirectional data flow, and modularization.

skills.name: buildr-uikit-bridge
skills.description: Expert guide for UIKit and SwiftUI interoperability. Covers UIViewRepresentable, UIViewControllerRepresentable, Coordinator delegate patterns, UIHostingController embedding, and lifecycle synchronization.

skills.name: buildr-multiplatform
skills.description: Expert guide for iPadOS and macOS multiplatform adaptations. Covers Stage Manager multitasking, Split View, Drag and Drop (.onDrag, .onDrop, Transferable), pointer interactions, and Mac Catalyst menu bars.

skills.name: buildr-concurrency
skills.description: Complete guide for Swift 6 data-race safety, actor isolation, Sendable enforcement, structured concurrency (TaskGroup, async let), cooperative cancellation, and compiler diagnostics.

skills.name: buildr-perf
skills.description: Diagnostic and profiling workflow for eliminating SwiftUI view churn, memory leaks, high CPU usage, retain cycles, and scroll hitches with Xcode Instruments.

skills.name: buildr-swiftdata
skills.description: Modern SwiftData persistence patterns. Covers @Model schemas, safe #Predicate expressions, ModelActor background processing, CloudKit sync constraints, and VersionedSchema migrations.

skills.name: buildr-coredata
skills.description: Enterprise Core Data architecture. Covers thread-safe context confinement, high-performance batch operations (NSBatchInsertRequest), persistent history tracking, and CloudKit sync.

skills.name: buildr-storekit
skills.description: Expert guide for Apple's StoreKit 2 and In-App Purchases. Covers Product queries, purchase flows, auto-renewable subscriptions, SubscriptionStoreView, transaction listeners (Transaction.updates), and .storekit testing.

skills.name: buildr-appstore
skills.description: Complete App Store readiness, submission review, and privacy compliance skill. Covers PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy (required reasons APIs, tracking domains), App Store Review guidelines, export compliance, and ASO metadata.

skills.name: buildr-api
skills.description: Enforces official Swift API Design Guidelines. Covers call-site clarity, grammatical argument labels, naming conventions, mutating/nonmutating pairs, and documentation comments.

skills.name: buildr-format
skills.description: Modern Foundation FormatStyle and .formatted() APIs. Replaces legacy DateFormatter and NumberFormatter with type-safe formatting for dates, currencies, numbers, durations, lists, and measurements.

skills.name: buildr-intents
skills.description: Apple App Intents framework (iOS 16+, 17, 18+). Covers AppIntent, AppEntity, EntityQuery, AppShortcutsProvider, interactive widgets, Siri shortcuts, and Apple Intelligence integration.

skills.name: buildr-widgets
skills.description: Deep engineering guide for WidgetKit and ActivityKit (iOS 16, 17, 18+). Covers TimelineProvider, interactive widgets, Live Activities, Dynamic Island layouts, and App Groups data sharing.

skills.name: buildr-background
skills.description: Apple platform background execution. Covers BGTaskScheduler (app refresh and processing tasks), background URLSession transfers, beginBackgroundTask expiration handlers, and silent push notifications.

skills.name: buildr-testing
skills.description: Modern Apple Swift Testing framework mastery. Covers @Test, @Suite, #expect, #require, parameterized table-driven tests, async testing, and XCTest migrations.

skills.name: buildr-debugger
skills.description: Systematic triage and debugging guide for runtime crashes (EXC_BAD_ACCESS, SIGABRT), LLDB command sequences, symbolication, and Thread/Address Sanitizer workflows.

skills.name: buildr-logs
skills.description: Apple Unified Logging, MetricKit, and performance signposts. Covers os.Logger, privacy redaction rules, OSSignposter tracing in Instruments, and metric payload collection.

skills.name: buildr-security
skills.description: Enterprise-grade iOS security and cryptography. Covers Keychain Services (SecItem), CryptoKit (AES-GCM, Secure Enclave, Curve25519), LocalAuthentication (Face ID / Touch ID), and certificate pinning.
